items.summary: Handoff: preserve the no-new-production-work posture. Review retained failed-run artifacts, document root cause, focused validation, rollback, and requeue-or-close disposition before any retry.

Approve the no-new-production-work posture. Continue only existing failure containment, deployed-improvement measurement, and bounded read-only security evidence capture. Do not requeue failed production changes until root cause, containment, focused validation, and rollback evidence are documented.

Keep the gated product private. The prepared external permission request remains an owner decision and must not be sent or used to change launch status without owner authorization, Legal disposition, and completion of technical, security, accuracy, and measurement gates.

Continue deployed-improvement measurement using only available impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, and site-attributed commission. Preserve unknown revenue, ROI, margin, incrementality, causal lift, and cost fields; do not request duplicate telemetry or infer missing values.

Continue bounded fleet security evidence capture using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Preserve unknowns where fleet-doctor and operations sweeps are unavailable; do not access credentials, private containers, permissions, or production.
